selected.title: CoreWeave: AI credit stress epicenter
selected.significance: CoreWeave closed $61.40 on 16 Oct, down 11.9% that day and 33% from $91.70 on 6 Oct; I read this as AI-borrower credit stress, not an end-demand collapse.

selected.title: Broad high-yield spreads tight before scare
selected.significance: Broad high-yield spreads were 3.23% on 15 Oct, before the 16 Oct CoreWeave scare; this cash-bond index may miss CDS and private credit, so the next print tests contagion.

selected.title: 10-year Treasury yield near 5.1%
selected.significance: The 10-year yield was 5.10% on 15 Oct, down from 5.31% on 5 Oct but still near the cycle high; high discount rates weigh on long-duration AI and software shares.

selected.title: TSMC: strong results, falling shares
selected.significance: TSMC fell 2.3% on 16 Oct despite record $46.7bn revenue and ~58% Q4 growth guidance; the drop fits sector de-rating and maintained capex/cautious 2027, not weak AI demand.

selected.title: Crescent Energy: deal-driven 10.3% jump
selected.significance: Crescent closed $13.79 on 16 Oct, up 10.3% on its $4.2bn Eagle Ford deal; that beat energy's +1.9% average and thin volume amplified it, so it is not proof of broad rotation.

selected.title: Micron: AI-memory rally reverses sharply
selected.significance: Micron closed at $878.78 on Oct. 16, down 5.6% that day and 27.7% from its June 25 high, as China supply, financing fears and profit-taking hit an extended memory trade.

selected.title: Micron operating income: highest in supplied data
selected.significance: Micron's fiscal 2026 Q3 operating income was $33.32B, the highest of three supplied quarters, so the selloff is not a current profit miss but a bet on future competition.

selected.title: 10-year Treasury yield: still near 5%
selected.significance: The 10-year Treasury yield was 5.10% on Oct. 15, down from 5.31% on Oct. 5 but still near 5%, keeping pressure on expensive AI shares.

selected.title: High-yield spreads: some widening, no broad shock
selected.significance: High-yield spreads were 3.23 percentage points on Oct. 15, up 63 basis points from 2.60 on Aug. 28 but below the 4.61 April 2025 peak: some widening, no broad credit shock.

selected.title: Humana: star-rating rally, then a pullback
selected.significance: Humana closed at $413.06 on Oct. 16, down 4.4% that day, after a roughly 12% rally on improved 2027 Medicare star ratings, so health-care strength was selective.
